snippet.description:
Types of Cusp in Differential Calculus: Classification of Cusps, First and Second Species explained. Master Cusp and Multiple Points concepts with step-by-step solved examples for B.Sc. Maths exams.

Iss lecture me hum Differential Calculus ke bohot important topic — Classification of Cusps (उभयाग्र के प्रकार) — ko detail me cover karenge. Pichle lecture me humne Multiple Points (Node, Cusp, aur Conjugate Points) ko identify karna sikha tha. Is session me hum Cusp ki geometry aur unke types ko depth me samjhenge.

📌 Topics Covered in This Video:
✅Cusp kya hota hai aur iski nature kaise determine karte hain?
✅ Common Tangent aur Common Normal ke respect me curve branches ka behavior
✅ Cusps of First Species (Keratoid Cusp) vs Cusps of Second Species (Ramphoid Cusp)
✅Single Cusp aur Double Cusp me kya difference hota hai?
✅University semester exams ke liye standard solved examples & step-by-step working rule

Timestamps
00:00 - Introduction & Recap of Multiple Points
03:08 - Classification of Cusps: Single Cusp vs Double Cusp
07:05 - Visualizing Single & Double Cusps on Curves
08:58 - Species of Cusps: First Species vs Second Species
13:12 - Graphical Representation of Cusp Species
16:16 - Summary Flowchart: Singular & Multiple Points
21:34 - Algorithm to Determine Nature of Cusp at Origin
29:28 - Solved Example 1: Finding Double Points & Nature of Cusp
43:35 - Solved Example 2: Step-by-Step Cusp Classification
58:12 - Conclusion & Overview of Next Lecture (Curve Tracing)

🎓 Yeh Video Kin Ke Liye Useful Hai:
🔸B.Sc, B.Sc B.Ed, Maths students 
🔸B.Tech Engineering Maths 
🔸GATE Mathematics 
🔸IIT JAM Mathematics

🔗 Previous Lecture:
Multiple Points: Node, Cusp & Conjugate Points   → https://youtu.be/o-zLEnUnklg

📺 Complete Playlist:
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLQ2PtdP6tVW8

Video pasand aaye toh Like karein aur Fractal Frontier Maths channel ko Subscribe karna na bhoolein. Koi bhi doubt ho toh comments mein zarur batayein!

📚 RECOMMENDED BOOKS / STUDY MATERIAL
If you want to study this topic in more depth, the following books are very helpful:

📘 Thomas' Calculus (15th Edition) – George B. Thomas, Maurice D. Weir & Joel R. Hass
👉 https://amzn.to/48DQjQW

📘 Single Variable Calculus (Hardcover) – James Stewart
👉 https://amzn.to/4cQeZbk

📘 Differential Calculus – Shanti Narayan & P.K. Mittal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cRttb2

📘 Integral Calculus – Shanti Narayan & P.K. Mittal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cReFsT

📘 Calculus, Vol. 1: One-Variable Calculus, with an Introduction to Linear Algebra – Tom M. Apostol
👉 https://amzn.to/4mBuoQ9

📘Higher Engineering Mathematics — B.S. Grewal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cz7dS7

📘Advanced Engineering Mathematics — Erwin Kreyszig
👉 https://amzn.to/41FY1pW

📘 Mathematical Methods for Physics and Engineering — K.F. Riley
👉 https://amzn.to/42cW0Sf

📘 Schaum’s Outline of Calculus
👉 https://amzn.to/4u0oxqd

Happy Learning! 📐✨

#DifferentialCalculus #BScMaths #Calculus #MultiplePoints #Cusp #EngineeringMathematics
